profile.dividendPolicy:
The Company has a dividend payment policy with the payout ratio of not less than 40 percent of the net profit of the separate financial statements after tax deduction, funding reserves as required by law and the Articles of Association of the Company, and obligations according to the terms and conditions of the financing contracts (if any). The dividend payment shall not exceed the retained earnings as disclosed in the Company's separate financial statements. In any given year, if the Company requires funds for investment or working capital, the Board of Directors may propose to the shareholders' meeting to consider paying dividends in other means. However, this dividend payout ratio may change depending on the operating results, cash flows, financial liquidity, financial position, investment plans, cash reserved for loan repayment, and working capital to be used in business operations and expansion, as well as economic circumstances and other factors as deemed appropriate by the Board of Directors. 
Annual dividend payment must be approved by the shareholders' meeting, except for the interim dividend payment, in which the Board of Directors may from time to time pay to shareholders such dividend payments if the Board of Directors estimates that the profits of the Company justify such payment. After the dividends have been paid, such dividend payment shall be reported to the shareholders at the next meeting of shareholders.
